parameters.query: with input_json as (select $1::jsonb as p), input_data as (select p->>'workflow_name' as workflow_name, p->>'spec_version' as spec_version, p->>'watchdog_execution_id' as watchdog_execution_id, p->>'repository_full_name' as repository_full_name, p->>'advisory_lock_key' as advisory_lock_key, coalesce((p->>'heartbeat_stale_threshold_seconds')::integer,900) as heartbeat_stale_threshold_seconds, coalesce((p->>'initial_retry_delay_minutes')::integer,5) as initial_retry_delay_minutes, coalesce((p->>'max_retry_delay_minutes')::integer,30) as max_retry_delay_minutes, coalesce((p->>'max_retries')::integer,3) as max_retries from input_json), lock_attempt AS MATERIALIZED (select pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext((select advisory_lock_key from input_data))::bigint) as lock_acquired), stale_candidates as (select r.workflow_run_id from moex_n8n_workflow_runs r cross join input_data d cross join lock_attempt la where la.lock_acquired = true and r.repository_full_name = d.repository_full_name and r.status = 'processing' and (r.lock_expires_at is null or r.lock_expires_at <= now() or r.last_heartbeat_at is null or r.last_heartbeat_at <= now() - (d.heartbeat_stale_threshold_seconds * interval '1 second')) order by r.updated_at asc for update skip locked), prepared as (select r.workflow_run_id, r.current_state as previous_state, r.status as previous_status, r.idempotency_key, r.repository_full_name, r.current_phase as previous_phase, r.retry_count as previous_retry_count, coalesce(r.retry_count,0) + 1 as next_retry_count, coalesce(r.max_retries,d.max_retries) as effective_max_retries, ((coalesce(r.retry_count,0) + 1) < coalesce(r.max_retries,d.max_retries)) as retry_allowed, least(d.max_retry_delay_minutes, d.initial_retry_delay_minutes * power(2, least(coalesce(r.retry_count,0),5))::integer) as retry_delay_minutes, r.worker_execution_id as previous_worker_execution_id, r.claim_token as previous_claim_token, r.locked_by as previous_locked_by, r.lock_expires_at as previous_lock_expires_at, r.last_heartbeat_at as previous_last_heartbeat_at from moex_n8n_workflow_runs r join stale_candidates c on c.workflow_run_id = r.workflow_run_id cross join input_data d), updated_runs as (update moex_n8n_workflow_runs r set status = case when p.retry_allowed then 'retry_wait' else 'fallback_required' end, current_state = case when p.retry_allowed then 'watchdog_retry_scheduled' else 'watchdog_fallback_required' end, current_phase = 'watchdog_error_handler', retry_count = p.next_retry_count, next_retry_at = case when p.retry_allowed then now() + (p.retry_delay_minutes * interval '1 minute') else null end, fallback_route = case when p.retry_allowed then r.fallback_route else 'manual_pm_l3_review' end, error_message = left(coalesce(nullif(r.error_message,'') || ' | ', '') || 'watchdog recovered stale processing run; previous_worker_execution_id=' || coalesce(p.previous_worker_execution_id,'null'), 8000), locked_by = null, worker_execution_id = null, claim_token = null, lock_expires_at = null, last_heartbeat_at = null, updated_at = now() from prepared p where r.workflow_run_id = p.workflow_run_id returning r.workflow_run_id, r.idempotency_key, p.previous_state, p.previous_status, r.status, r.current_state, r.current_phase, r.retry_count, r.max_retries, r.next_retry_at, r.fallback_route, r.error_message, p.retry_allowed, p.retry_delay_minutes, p.previous_worker_execution_id, p.previous_claim_token, p.previous_locked_by, p.previous_lock_expires_at, p.previous_last_heartbeat_at), released_locks as (update moex_n8n_workflow_locks l set status = 'released_by_watchdog', expires_at = now(), last_heartbeat_at = now() from updated_runs u where l.workflow_run_id = u.workflow_run_id and l.status <> 'released_by_watchdog' returning l.workflow_run_id), step_started as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs (workflow_run_id, step_name, status, attempt, input_hash, started_at, completed_at, error_message, created_at, updated_at) select u.workflow_run_id, 'watchdog_error_handler', 'completed', u.retry_count, u.idempotency_key, now(), now(), u.error_message, now(), now() from updated_runs u where not exists (select 1 from moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs s where s.workflow_run_id = u.workflow_run_id and s.step_name = 'watchdog_error_handler' and s.attempt = u.retry_count) returning workflow_run_id), event_inserted as (insert into moex_n8n_workflow_run_events (workflow_run_id, previous_state, new_state, event_type, event_payload_json, created_at) select u.workflow_run_id, u.previous_state, u.current_state, case when u.retry_allowed then 'watchdog_retry_scheduled' else 'watchdog_fallback_required' end, jsonb_build_object('workflow_name',(select workflow_name from input_data),'spec_version',(select spec_version from input_data),'watchdog_execution_id',(select watchdog_execution_id from input_data),'previous_status',u.previous_status,'previous_state',u.previous_state,'new_status',u.status,'new_state',u.current_state,'retry_count',u.retry_count,'max_retries',u.max_retries,'next_retry_at',u.next_retry_at,'retry_allowed',u.retry_allowed,'retry_delay_minutes',u.retry_delay_minutes,'previous_worker_execution_id',u.previous_worker_execution_id,'previous_claim_token',u.previous_claim_token,'previous_locked_by',u.previous_locked_by,'previous_lock_expires_at',u.previous_lock_expires_at,'previous_last_heartbeat_at',u.previous_last_heartbeat_at,'worker_execution_id_cleared',true,'claim_token_cleared',true,'last_heartbeat_null_treated_as_stale',true,'effective_worker_lock_ttl_minutes_waiver',65), now() from updated_runs u returning event_id, workflow_run_id), summary as (select la.lock_acquired, coalesce(count(u.workflow_run_id),0)::integer as recovered_count, coalesce(count(u.workflow_run_id) filter (where u.retry_allowed),0)::integer as retry_scheduled_count, coalesce(count(u.workflow_run_id) filter (where not u.retry_allowed),0)::integer as fallback_required_count from lock_attempt la left join updated_runs u on true group by la.lock_acquired) select (select workflow_name from input_data) as workflow_name, (select spec_version from input_data) as spec_version, (select watchdog_execution_id from input_data) as watchdog_execution_id, s.lock_acquired, s.recovered_count, s.retry_scheduled_count, s.fallback_required_count, (select count(*)::integer from released_locks) as released_lock_rows, (select count(*)::integer from event_inserted) as event_rows, (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('workflow_run_id',u.workflow_run_id,'status',u.status,'current_state',u.current_state,'retry_count',u.retry_count,'max_retries',u.max_retries,'next_retry_at',u.next_retry_at,'fallback_route',u.fallback_route,'retry_allowed',u.retry_allowed) order by u.workflow_run_id),'[]'::jsonb) from updated_runs u) as recovered_runs from summary s;
